description: When closing a pane asks first, and the words it asks in, shared by the Mac and iOS clients (PaneClosePolicy) and the desktop client (soyeht_client::pane_close). A pane that runs a process (a terminal, an agent or a web page) always asks, whether or not anything is running in it. A document and an editor tab ask by rules of their own (writing.json `closing`, and the editor's conflict with the disk), so with nothing to lose they close at once. Closing a workspace asks whenever it holds at least one pane, because closing it closes every pane in it (`workspaces`); a workspace with no pane closes at once. Its folder and files are never touched. Every client passes the `workspaces` cases, replacing `{place}` with its own entry of `places`: the folder lives on the Mac for the Mac and iOS clients and on this computer for the desktop client.
